import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    costs = []
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if odd == even:
            costs.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

    costs.sort()
    spent = 0
    cuts = 0
    for cost in costs:
        if spent + cost <= b:
            spent += cost
            cuts += 1
        else:
            break
    print(cuts)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
